english:
Precision Hits with a Bow or Sniper Rifle grant a stack of Reload at Range for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Reload at Range benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 10|20|30|40|50 Reload Speed
• 2%|4%|6%|8%|10% decreased Reload Animation Duration

source.text:
Upon scoring a Precision Hit with a Bow or Sniper Rifle:

Grants a stack of Reload at Range for 5 seconds, up to 5 stacks.

Reload at Range:
x1 | +10 Reload Speed and 0.98x Reload Duration Multiplier.
x2 | +20 Reload Speed and 0.96x Reload Duration Multiplier.
x3 | +30 Reload Speed and 0.94x Reload Duration Multiplier.
x4 | +40 Reload Speed and 0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier.
x5 | +50 Reload Speed and 0.90x Reload Duration Multiplier.
